summary: Backend regression for Audit-Step 2.1 (services/entry_guard.py refactor). All 7 requested unit test files run green (69/69 passed). API smoke on preview URL passes 11/11 after retry: /api/health=200, login OK with Admin/Dean06Greif!/Admin, bad password=401, unauth /api/autotrade/balance=401, authed /api/autotrade/{balance,capital,trades,sync-status,slippage-stats}=200. Risk-budget & trade-guard endpoints live under /api/risk-budget[/config] and /api/trade-guard (NOT /api/notify/...  as stated in review — actual paths confirmed in routers/notify.py). GET /api/risk-budget returns {config: {enabled, max_portfolio_risk_pct, max_cluster_risk_pct}, usage: {mode, open_risk_usdt, by_cluster, open_trades}} as required. Round-trip POST /api/risk-budget/config {max_portfolio_risk_pct:5} then restored to 6 verified via GET. GET /api/trade-guard returns config+state+states as expected. entry_guard hooks visible in services/bitunix_trade.py: EntryChecks() @1779, check_entry @1891, check_risk_budget @2155, 'entry_checks': checks.to_list() persisted at 2606. No trades opened. Single transient 502 on first /api/health call was ingress cold-start (same pattern as iter58), stable 200 on retry — no code defect.

minor.issue: Occasional ingress cold-start 502 on first hit after idle; recovers within 1-2s. Same as documented in iter58. Consider startup warmup or higher ingress timeout.
